text.text_excerpt: If you only book ONE TOUR in New Orleans, make it this one. Elizabeth is amazing and she has a wealth of knowledge (not just on alcohol related things). Her stories were interesting, entertaining and there wasn't one moment I checked my watch to see when the tour ended, in fact I was kind of sad when it was over! Elizabeth makes all the drinks, color codes them and packs them into a cooler carry bag for you. You can keep the cups and the card with directions to make each of the drinks. The best part is you know you are getting the historical truth on this tour because as she said "This is New Orleans, you don't have to make shit up!" (we ran into some inaccurate story telling on another t...

We booked our reservations over the phone and paid in cash on the day of ($5 off per person for cash payments) Elizabeth was such a great guide! She educated us on the history of New Orleans and of the drinks we were provided. Before the tour began, we were given a satchel of drinks - St. Charles Hotel Punch, Sazerac, Hurricane, & Praline Liquor. Elizabeth asked us to take out each drink at a certain point and educated us on it. Such a great way to see New Orleans in a 2 hour period!

Elizabeth and Monique, I thoroughly enjoyed your tour! I learned a lot about the city that I did not know. The cocktails you prepared were thoughtfully done. Your book has a permanent spot on my coffee table and I can't wait to thumb through it as I plan my next bar crawl.
